description: This file contains a Spring component named VariableLoanScheduleFromApiJsonValidator responsible for validating JSON input for variable loan schedule modifications. It ensures the JSON structure and parameters meet specific business rules for loan installment modifications, including validating dates, amounts, and supported parameters within the context of a loan object.

classes.name: VariableLoanScheduleFromApiJsonValidator
classes.description: A Spring component that validates JSON input related to variable loan schedules, ensuring supported parameters, correct data types and formats, and consistency with loan status and product details.

methods.name: validateSchedule
methods.description: Validates the JSON input for loan schedule modifications, checking for required structure, supported parameters, and logical consistency based on the current loan state.

methods.name: validateLoanTermVariations
methods.description: Validates individual loan installment modifications within the provided JSON array, checking parameter correctness, date validations, and amount constraints.
